theorem final_wf : ∀ (P Q : Bool), (P = true ∨ Q = true) → P = false → Q = true := by sorry

theorem final_neg : ¬ (∀ (P Q : Bool), (P = true ∨ Q = true) → P = false → Q = true) := by fv_auto
